newsitem.title: USA: Getty Communciations acquires Energy Film.
newsitem.headline: Getty Communciations acquires Energy Film.

text.p: Getty Communications Plc said Monday that it has acquired Energy Film Library, a Los Angeles-based company that provides generic still and moving images to the advertising, television, feature film, corporate communications and multi-media busisnesses.
Terms of the acquisition were not released.
Getty said the company owns 25 percent of its collection, which allows it earn higher margins on footage sales.
Getty provides visual content to advertising and design agencies, magazines, newspapers, book and new media publishers, broadcasters and other corporations.
It also markets reproduction and broadcasting rights to still and moving images through its international distribution network.
